title: Well made, easy to clean, great for candy making!
text: Well made, easy to clean, great for candy making!. This is a great pan for making small cookies or candies. Heavy, well made and easy to clean, this is a great way to make smaller sized treats for your family and friends. I especially like this for chocolates and have made several batches already and clean up is a breeze (practically rinses clean without needing a sponge). I highly recommend this pan for you or the chef in your life. Keep in mind the size of the cookies/candies when selecting this pan.
